# NestJS Observe

> NestJS Observe is the official, auto-instrumented observability platform for NestJS applications - APM, distributed tracing, error monitoring, logs, alerts and SLOs. Install the `@nestjs/observe` SDK, add an API key, and the application's requests, jobs, errors, logs and traces stream to the dashboard with no manual span wiring and no collector to run.

Every plan, Free included, has error monitoring, distributed tracing and auto-instrumentation. Paid plans add logs streaming, alerting and team management, and Scale and above add SSO and SLOs. A live demo of the dashboard over a busy service's data, with no signup, is at https://www.observe-demo.nestjs.com/dashboard.

The pages below are the product documentation as plain markdown.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/overview.md): What Observe is, how teams, projects and applications fit together, and your first project.
- [Applications](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/applications.md): Projects, applications, API keys, teams, and access control.
- [SDK](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/sdk.md): Instrument your NestJS application.
- [Telemetry](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/telemetry.md): Requests, errors, jobs, traces, logs, and everything else your project dashboard shows.
- [Traces & spans](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/traces.md): The waterfall, self time, error source frames, and handing a failure to a coding agent.
- [Using the MCP server](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/mcp.md): Let an MCP-compatible agent query your telemetry, issues, and alerts directly.
- [Users](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/users.md): Per-user activity, grouped actions, and the paths between them.
- [Profiler](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/profiler.md): CPU, memory, event loop, and garbage collection per process.
- [Alerts](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/alerts.md): Get notified when your telemetry crosses a threshold.
- [SLOs](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/slos.md): Objectives and error budgets over existing telemetry.
- [Issues](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/issues.md): Track the work that comes out of your telemetry.
- [Billing & usage](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/billing.md): Plans, usage, cost attribution, and spend controls.
- [FAQ](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms/faq.md): Setup, pricing and retention, data privacy, and how Observe compares to self-hosted OpenTelemetry.

## Optional

- [All of the above in one file](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Observability chapter of the NestJS docs](https://docs.nestjs.com/observability/overview.md): installing and configuring the @nestjs/observe SDK in a NestJS application.
